meta.guidance:
High-Level Story / Structure 
The video will start with the artist walking in the store. In between, she will firstly introduce herself and her business. Then, she will talk about her dream and the reason she likes her job. Afterwards, there will be some footage of her working with the clay. She will then talk about the significance of handmade objects and there will be some footage of her work. The video will end with her walking out of the store. The music will be funky but low volume.

5 Requirements

1. The clip "walking in" will begin the video.

2. The clip "shaping clay on the wheel" will come before the clip "I think physical mediums are so important because, um, it's a way of connecting.".

3. The music will only play when Viviana is not speaking.

4. The video will end with the clip "walking out".

5. The clip "mud witch sign on shelf" will come right before she leaves the store.
